compiled_state.title: [brainstorm]: External-dependency feasibility check missed GitHub auto-merge requirement -> PR-mode workflow exited 1 in repos with auto-merge disabled
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 284db0c34c1faa77ce6f125b194f5759504fcef5
* **affected_skill:** /dso:brainstorm (epic 09b0-1d25-1a7d-4cf1)
* **affected_script:** plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh
* **observed_repo:** navapbc/digital-service-orchestra (auto-merge disabled at repo level)

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

The brainstorm phase for epic 09b0-1d25-1a7d-4cf1 (\"PR Merge Remediation Loop: Autonomous CI Failure Resolution\") should have probed the deployment environment's capability surface — specifically the GitHub repository setting `Allow auto-merge` — and either (a) flagged auto-merge as an external dependency requiring confirmation per `docs/contracts/external-dependencies-block.md`, or (b) designed a fallback path for the auto-merge-disabled case.

The DSO brainstorm scrutiny pipeline includes feasibility review, but did not catch that the entire PR-mode design hinges on a repo-level GitHub setting that may be disabled in many real environments.

#### Actual Behavior

Epic 09b0-1d25-1a7d-4cf1 was implemented and verified end-to-end without auto-merge being identified as an external dependency. On first real-world use (this very repository), the merge-to-main-pr.sh script exited 1 immediately after creating PR #45:

```
ERROR: GitHub auto-merge is disabled for this repository.
       Enable it under Settings → General → 'Allow auto-merge', then re-run with --resume.
       (gh stderr: GraphQL: Auto merge is not allowed for this repository (enablePullRequestAutoMerge))
CONFLICT_DATA {\"branch\": \"worktree-20260503-193618\", \"base_branch\": \"main\", \"conflicted_files\": [], \"resolution_strategy\": \"pr-conflict\"}
```

This emitted a misleading `pr-conflict` resolution_strategy (no actual conflict existed) and prevented the remediation loop the epic itself was designed to deliver from ever running. A separate fix (this commit) was required to fall through to manual merge when auto-merge is disabled.

### 3. Action History

1. /dso:brainstorm 09b0-1d25-1a7d-4cf1 — produced 5 stories; no External Dependencies block flagged auto-merge.
2. /dso:sprint 09b0-1d25-1a7d-4cf1 — implemented all 5 stories; tests + completion-verifier all passed.
3. /dso:end-session-style attempt — `.claude/scripts/dso merge-to-main.sh` invoked, branch pushed, PR #45 created.
4. `gh pr merge 45 --auto --merge` rejected by GitHub: auto-merge disabled at repo level. Script exited 1.

### 4. Chronological Rationalization

The brainstorm scrutiny pipeline (red team / blue team / feasibility reviewer) is intended to surface implicit deployment-environment assumptions. `docs/contracts/external-dependencies-block.md` exists specifically for this. But the existing checklist did not include \"GitHub repo-level settings that gate the workflow's success path\" as a probe dimension. Auto-merge falls into a class of dependency that:

* Is configured outside the repository (Settings → General).
* Is not visible in the codebase or in any plugin file.
* Affects only one phase of the workflow but blocks the entire pipeline.

This category is currently unenumerated.

### 5. Skills and Workflows

* **/dso:brainstorm** — should add a probe dimension for external-system settings the workflow depends on (GitHub repo settings, GitHub Actions secrets, branch protection rules, required-checks rulesets).
* **plugins/dso/skills/shared/prompts/external-dependencies-shape-heuristic.md** (if it exists) — extend with a \"workflow-gating settings\" sub-category.
* **dso:feasibility-reviewer** — when an integration involves PR auto-merge, must verify auto-merge is a probed dimension.

### 6. Logs

```
INFO: Created PR #45: https://github.com/navapbc/digital-service-orchestra/pull/45
ERROR: GitHub auto-merge is disabled for this repository.
       Enable it under Settings → General → 'Allow auto-merge', then re-run with --resume.
       (gh stderr: GraphQL: Auto merge is not allowed for this repository (enablePullRequestAutoMerge))
CONFLICT_DATA {\"branch\": \"worktree-20260503-193618\", \"base_branch\": \"main\", \"conflicted_files\": [], \"resolution_strategy\": \"pr-conflict\"}
```

comments.body: Fix applied: brainstorm SKILL.md Phase 1 Step 3 adds a Platform capability probe — 4 GitHub repo-level capabilities (auto-merge allowed, branch protection, merge methods, required check contexts) explicitly enumerated when SC mentions github/PR/merge keywords. Committed in cef107b8cc.
